vb_textbox.text: Ignore everything about the mushroom friends that you select, ONLY PAY ATTENTION TO IF THEIR HATS ARE TALL OR FLAT......... 1) Choose the flat-cap mushroom over and over until you get +3 or below. 2) Now choose the tall-cap mushroom over and over until you get +3 or below. 3) Keep doing this and you WILL score highly.
